steps.note: what the agent can and cannot do, then the exact line
steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Connect your coding agent" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Paste one line into a terminal (a shell, not your agent's chat). Pasting it is your yes to adding Foundry. Foundry doesn't change your agent's settings for you.
  - heading "What your agent can and can't do with Foundry" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: Draft an automation from what you ask for.
    - listitem: Test it with pretend data.
    - listitem: "It can't turn anything on through Foundry: you do."
    - listitem: "It can't approve what an automation makes through Foundry: you do, in a dialog or in this page. An agent allowed to run any command as you could; see How this is kept safe."
  - heading "Claude Code Preview" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "In a terminal, inside the project where you'll use Foundry:"
  - text: claude mcp add --transport stdio foundry -- "/opt/node24/bin/node" "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" mcp --dashboard --consent --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-ungrounded-EGGiu1"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Or, for every project:"
  - text: claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio foundry -- "/opt/node24/bin/node" "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" mcp --dashboard --consent --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-ungrounded-EGGiu1"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Then start claude there and type /mcp: foundry should show as connected. Claude Code always asks you before ask_person_to_turn_on runs. Other Foundry tools may run without asking, depending on your permission mode (in auto mode, a classifier reviews tool calls instead of asking you). Tested with a scripted client, not yet with a released Claude Code."
  - group: "▸ Optional: let your agent draft and test without asking each time. Add these names to permissions, allow, in your Claude Code settings:"
  - heading "Cursor Preview" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Add this to .cursor/mcp.json in your project, or to your user settings:"
  - text: "{ \"mcpServers\": { \"foundry\": { \"command\": \"/opt/node24/bin/node\", \"args\": [ \"/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs\", \"mcp\", \"--dashboard\", \"--consent\", \"--workspace\", \"/tmp/journey-p1-ungrounded-EGGiu1\" ] } } }"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Or use a one-click link (built from Cursor's documented format; not yet tried in Cursor): Preview"
  - text: cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=foundry&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoiL29wdC9ub2RlMjQvYmluL25vZGUiLCJhcmdzIjpbIi9ob21lL3VzZXIvd29ya2Zsb3ctZm91bmRyeS8uY2xhdWRlL3dvcmt0cmVlcy93Zl9jNzk0NjQ2OC0yMDMtMTYvYXBwL2NsaS5tanMiLCJtY3AiLCItLWRhc2hib2FyZCIsIi0tY29uc2VudCIsIi0td29ya3NwYWNlIiwiL3RtcC9qb3VybmV5LXAxLXVuZ3JvdW5kZWQtRUdHaXUxIl19
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Cursor shows you the server before it adds it. Foundry asks for your decisions in your browser, not in Cursor's own dialog: it can't look for hooks in Cursor that could answer that dialog for you. Tested with a scripted client, not yet in Cursor."
  - heading "Codex Preview" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "In a terminal:"
  - text: codex mcp add foundry -- "/opt/node24/bin/node" "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" mcp --dashboard --consent --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-ungrounded-EGGiu1"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Codex documents a setting that lets an MCP server's dialog reach you (approval_policy.granular.mcp_elicitations in its config reference, read 2026-10-21); with it off, Codex turns the dialog down by itself. Foundry doesn't use Codex's dialog, because it can't look for what could answer it for you: it opens your browser when it needs your yes. Tested with a scripted client, not yet with a released Codex."
  - heading "Plugin from your own copy Planned" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Planned: one step that adds Foundry and a short guide for your agent, from a copy on this computer. Nothing would be published."
  - 'link "What you can do today: paste the line above"':
    - /url: "#/connect-agent"
  - paragraph: "Then ask your agent, for example:"
  - text: use Foundry to chase my unpaid invoices, summary to me@example.com
  - paragraph: "Foundry can make these today:"
  - list:
    - listitem: Chase unpaid invoices
    - listitem: Approve small expenses
    - listitem: Weekly progress report
    - listitem: Route new leads
    - listitem: Answer common support questions
    - listitem: On-call alert digest
    - listitem: Keep the newsletter list in step
  - paragraph: "To open Foundry's page yourself, at any time:"
  - text: node "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" open --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-ungrounded-EGGiu1"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Nothing was written to any config file. Paste one of these. Your agent cannot turn anything on through Foundry: ask_person_to_turn_on asks you, in Claude Code's dialog only when Foundry finds nothing that could answer that dialog for you, otherwise in Foundry's page. A hook Foundry cannot see could still answer the dialog."
  - group: ▸ Show details
